actorSortUnit.rule: body, dress, weapon and helmet must stay on final world z_index 0 and enter actor_y_sort as one subtree

invariants: Every body and equipment CanvasItem has final world z_index 0, matching actor_y_sort wall fronts.
Equipment front/back order uses sibling tree order, never z_index offsets.
No equipment child is top_level or uses z_as_relative=false.
A wall-front actor_y_sort unit in front of the actor feet occludes body, dress, weapon and helmet together.
A wall-front actor_y_sort unit behind the actor feet leaves the complete actor visible.
